rule: A Hebrew-on-Hebrew definition is served only from a volume this record declares served, and this record declares nothing it was not told. A volume absent from served_volumes is not served, whatever anyone believes about it; an entry Ben Yehuda marked with an asterisk is not served until the asterisk read is done, whatever volume it stands in. No licence is as absolute as a forbidding one, and silence here forbids.

work.title: A Complete Dictionary of Ancient and Modern Hebrew
work.author: Eliezer Ben Yehuda
work.what_it_is: Hebrew defined in Hebrew, with the ancient citations that carry each sense, the author's own explanatory prose, glosses in European languages, and comparanda from cognate languages. The layers are not one thing and are not served as one thing: see strata.

basis_as_stated: the author's death plus the term that applied where the work was published, as the owner and the corpus lane read it
no explicit retroactive change the owner or the corpus lane could point to
not published in the United States in the first instance
volumes 15 and 16 were filed in the United States and are out on that ground alone; volumes 8 to 14 were not ruled on either way
ruling.what_this_is_not: a legal finding. It is the owner's ruling, recorded on the date it was given, with the reasons the owner gave. A reader is shown the volume an entry stands in and this record's posture for that volume, and nothing stronger.

not_declared.reader: an entry from one of these volumes is emitted held, by volume, with no text: the headword and the volume print, the definition does not

floor.said: volume 7 ends at the headword whose key is the value above, the last headword under nun that the served volumes reach; a headword whose first letter is past nun is in a volume this record does not declare, and a headword under nun that sorts after the floor is too
floor.per_volume_letter_ranges: not yet delivered — the corpus lane is reading them; until then the only volume this record can name for a headword is 'one of 1 to 7' or 'past the floor'

strata.rule: each stratum of an entry is typed by the corpus lane at delivery and is served or withheld by its type, never by guessing at the text

quote.what: a citation from an ancient source, printed as the source's own words with each word answering from the same catalog as the page

prose.channel: not yet ruled — red or blue is the owner's call
prose.what: the author's own explanatory Hebrew, modern; served as his, marked as his

foreign.what: glosses in German, French, English and other European languages; counted at build, never emitted — the page serves Hebrew and answers in English from its own catalog, not from a third language

comparandum.what: cognates in Arabic, Aramaic, Akkadian and others; counted at build, never emitted until ruled on

asterisk.rule: an entry whose headword Ben Yehuda marked with an asterisk is a word he coined or reconstructed. The owner's ruling (2026-09-12) is that no coinage is served, anywhere, ever. Such an entry is emitted held, with its headword, its volume and the reason, and no text, until the corpus lane's asterisk read is delivered and the owner has ruled on what it found.
